title: Al-Ghashiyah 88:1-5 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Ghashiyah, the makharij and the rules of laam
source: Written for quran/y5 lesson 9 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Ghashiyah 88:1-5 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 9. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَٰشِيَةِ (١) وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ (٢) عَامِلَةٌۭ نَّاصِبَةٌۭ (٣) تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةًۭ (٤) تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍۢ (٥)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
[Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,
They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.
They will be given drink from a boiling spring.

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Full mouth; the laam of al- is clear

keywords.def: the Overwhelming: a name of the Day of Judgement

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Ghashiyah 88:1-5 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 88:1-5 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 88:1-5 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: On the pupil PDF, write the meaning of 88:2 in your own words.
questions.a: On that Day some faces will be humbled (lowered in fear).

questions.q: Find two izhar examples in 88:1 to 5 and name the throat letters.
questions.a: نَارًا حَامِيَةًۭ (ح), مِنْ عَيْنٍ (ع), عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍۢ (ء).

questions.q: Al-Ghashiyah (the Overwhelming) is a name for ...
questions.a: A) the Day of Judgement. The surah describes the faces on that Day (88:2 to 16): it is the Day of Judgement.

questions.q: Think again: The surah opens with a question: 'Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming?' Why might Allah begin with a question?
questions.a: A question makes us stop and listen. Al-Ghashiyah is a name for the Day of Judgement, which will overwhelm everyone.
